examples.arabic: كلنا قعدنا قدام التلفزيون في الصالون بتاعنا.
examples.english: All of us sat in front of the television in our living room.
examples.transliteration: Kollena 2a3adna 2oddam el televiseon fi el saloon beta3na.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: جدي عايز يتفرج على التلفزيون بس اخويا بيشتغل على اللاب توب
examples.english: My grandpa wants to watch television but my brother is working on the laptop.
examples.transliteration: Geddi ayez yetfarrag ala el televizion bas akhouya biyeshtaghal ala el laptop.

examples.english: I sat on the sofa and watched television.
examples.transliteration: A'adt 'ala el kanaba w shoft televizyon.
